workload.hms_commit_granularity: one transaction per document; a batch is announced after its last document commits

power_loss_method: LD_PRELOAD shim: fsync/fdatasync/msync copy the synced file under a shadow root keyed by device and inode (a rename keeps the inode, so atomic temp-and-rename publication is honoured without intercepting rename); after SIGKILL every store file is reset to its last synced copy and never-synced files are removed, i.e. every write after the last sync is lost; directory-entry durability (a rename not followed by a directory fsync) is taken as durable

run1 (hms, sqlite, all cells).note: its power_loss cells are superseded: the shim rewrote shadow copies in place, so a kill landing inside a copy truncated the shadow (bytes_after far below bytes_at_kill in every failing row); first-run power_loss numbers kept here for the record

run3 (lucene, all cells).note: the first Lucene attempt crashed at kill_compaction point 182 on a segment file deleted by a merge during size accounting; the harness now skips vanished files

verdict.hms_vs_sqlite: HMS passes every kill, power-loss, reader, snapshot and old-binary cell SQLite passes and loses no committed document in 450 crash points; HMS fails torn_write (10 silent of 50) where SQLite passes (48 detected, 0 silent), and detects fewer bit flips as silent-free (11 silent vs SQLite 35 silent, both fail); HMS recovery is 12.9-13.8 ms median against SQLite 0.7-2.1 ms. Target not met: corruption detection.
verdict.hms_vs_lucene: Lucene passes all eight cells with 50/50 detection on both corruption cells (per-file checksums); HMS recovers 13x faster (13 ms vs 174-185 ms median) and snapshots in 3.3 ms vs 2.1 ms (Lucene) and 26 ms (SQLite). Target not met: corruption detection and the torn-write cell.
verdict.product_gap: the arena frames carry CRC32 but the JSON manifests (store.json, indices.json) and some frame regions let corruption through unreported: 10 torn sectors and 11 bit flips were served as missing or wrong documents with hms-admin verify reporting a clean store; a manifest checksum and a verify that cross-checks document presence against the index would close it
